ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution in the form of spots, streaks, and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate spots and linear streaks distributed across both lobes; dense high-intensity pixel clustering at the distal tips (lobes) and at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary; right lobe trailing edge shows higher frequency of micro-peaks (3-8 pixel amplitude); left lobe shows larger, more rounded undulating valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep converging toward the center; leading edges (visible at tips) show a convex curvature transitioning to distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and oval high-contrast white clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered bilaterally, likely representing barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notable long diagonal rake mark on the mid-right lobe; several horizontal and intersecting streaks on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) across both lobes; significant barnacle colonization (biological encrustation) at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-tan biological mass (active barnacle colony) localized at the extreme right distal tip, creating a distinct texture profile relative to the fluke skin.
